output: I hear you, and you're right that spreadsheets stay part of most finance workflows, including board packs. The spreadsheet add-in is built for that reality: it refreshes data into your workbook and can write changes back, so you can avoid a full manual export each quarter. We also offer formatted report templates that cover the common board and management layouts. If your board pack needs a highly custom layout, you may still finish some of it in a spreadsheet, and we'll be clear about that. As a proof point, a finance team replaced a manual monthly export with add-in refresh: [PLACEHOLDER] customer story. Would you be open to a short working session where we rebuild one of your current spreadsheet reports together? That will show you where the add-in fits and where it doesn't.
